comparison.interpretation: Reuse already-owned deeply immutable model nodes only after freshly decoding and validating their current shared contents and checking exact child identity, normalized attributes, marks and bindings. Per-read ownership prevents identity aliasing; mutable host defaults and custom text validators retain fresh factory behavior. Primary measured benefit is memory for explicitly retained immutable snapshots. No general typing-speed claim, default switch, compaction, migration, version/limit increase or publication.
